sources.title: Cruz Unveils SANDBOX Act to Ease Federal AI Rules
sources.snippet: The SANDBOX Act instructs federal agencies to coordinate with state programs, but Cruz and Kratsios made clear their ultimate aim was to prevent states from imposing conflicting rules. "We must prevent a patchwork of burdensome AI regulation, including oft conflicting state AI regulations," Cruz said.
